author: saltandsawdust
text: Salt and Sawdust. I buy dead workshops and find out why they died. #saltandsawdust #restoration

author: saltandsawdust
text: Bought a shuttered cooperage for the price of clearing it. Everything inside was still where the last cooper left it, including his lunch. #restoration

author: saltandsawdust
text: The cooperage lathe runs. It took eleven days and a bearing I had to have cut by hand. #restoration #tools

author: saltandsawdust
text: Someone in the comments knew the cooper. Says he stopped because the barrels stopped. I am going to find out what that means. #restoration
